content.body:
## Task

Implement backend operations to create, edit and delete trainings,
and manage learner assignments. Include automated tests.

## Acceptance Criteria

### Create trainings
- Learners can create trainings automatically assigned to themselves.
- Learners cannot assign trainings to others.
- Admins can create trainings without assignments or assign selected learners.
- Only users with the LEARNER role can receive assignments.
- Training creation and initial assignments succeed or fail together.

### Edit trainings
- Learners can edit only trainings they created.
- Admins can edit any training.
- Changes apply to all learners assigned to that training.
- Existing completion statuses are preserved.
- The training's creator cannot be changed.

### Manage assignments
- Admins can select or deselect learners on an existing training.
- Newly assigned learners start incomplete.
- Learners who remain assigned keep their completion status.
- Unassigning removes the assignment and its completion record.
- Reassigning a removed learner starts incomplete.
- Duplicate assignments are prevented.
- Assignment changes succeed or fail together.

### Delete trainings
- Admins can delete trainings even when learners are assigned.
- Deletion removes associated assignments and completion records.
- Learners can delete only trainings they created and only when
  no assignments exist; otherwise return 409 Conflict.
- Deletion and assignment removal succeed or fail together.

### Validation and permissions
- Training names must not be blank or exceed 200 characters.
- Invalid input, missing records and denied access return appropriate errors.
- User identity comes from authentication, not a client-supplied user ID.

## Scope

- Request and response DTOs.
- Service logic and repository operations.
- Protected creation, update, deletion and assignment endpoints.
- Automated tests for successful operations, validation, permissions,
  and preservation or removal of completion records.
-Training operations implemented and tested; login integration comes in the authentication task.

## Dependencies

Authentication is required to complete protected endpoints.
Service logic and tests can be implemented beforehand.

## Out of Scope

- Training retrieval, implemented in #22.
- Marking assignments as completed.
- Progress calculation.
- Learning materials.

## Definition of Done

- Acceptance criteria are implemented.
- Relevant automated tests pass.
- Endpoints are verified locally.
- Code is reviewed.

## Task

Design and implement the persistence model required for trainings,
their creators, and individual learner assignments.

## Scope

- Define and document the initial data model.
- Create minimal user persistence with an ID, display name, and role
  to support training relationships.
- Create training persistence with a name and creator.
- Create assignment persistence linking a training to a learner,
  including the learner's completion timestamp.
- Create the corresponding Flyway migration, JPA entities,
  and repositories.
- Prevent duplicate assignments of the same training to a learner.

## Out of Scope

- Login and authentication.
- User-management endpoints.
- Training creation and assignment endpoints.
- Completion endpoints and progress calculation.
- Permission enforcement in API requests.

## Definition of Done

- Flyway creates the required tables and constraints.
- JPA entities map correctly to the database.
- Repositories are available.
- The backend starts successfully with schema validation enabled.
- The data model and scope decisions are documented.
- The team's shared Definition of Done is satisfied.

## User Story

As a learner,
I want to log in to Academy Hub,
so that I can access my personal Academy information.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The learner can enter login credentials.
- The learner can submit the login form.
- Valid credentials allow access to Academy Hub.
- Invalid credentials display an understandable error message.
- A logged-out user cannot access protected pages.
- After a successful login, the learner is redirected into the application.
content.title: US-01: Learner login

content.body:
## User Story

As a learner,
I want to see my dashboard,
so that I have an overview of my relevant Academy information.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The learner can access the dashboard after logging in.
- The dashboard displays the information available in MVP Version 1.
- The dashboard displays the learner's training progress.
- The dashboard provides access to the learner's trainings.
- Features that are not part of MVP Version 1 do not need to be functional.
- The dashboard loads without critical errors.
content.title: US-02: View learner dashboard

content.body:
## User Story

As a learner,
I want to see my trainings,
so that I know which trainings are available to me.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The learner can open the Training Tracker.
- The learner can see a list of available trainings.
- Each training displays at least its name.
- The learner can see the current status of each training.
- Completed and incomplete trainings can be distinguished.
- If no trainings are available, an appropriate empty-state message is displayed.
content.title: US-03: View trainings

content.body:
## User Story

As a learner,
I want to mark a training as completed,
so that my completed training is recorded.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The learner can mark an incomplete training as completed.
- The training status changes to Completed.
- The completion status is saved.
- The completed status remains after the page is refreshed.
- The updated status is visible in the Training Tracker.
- Completing a training updates the learner's training progress.
content.title: US-04: Mark training as completed

content.body:
## User Story

As a learner,
I want to see my training progress,
so that I can understand how much of my training I have completed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The learner can see their current training progress.
- Progress is calculated based on completed and available trainings.
- The displayed progress updates when a training is marked as completed.
- The progress value is presented clearly.
- The learner can distinguish completed progress from remaining progress.
- The progress is visible in the relevant Training Tracker or dashboard view.
content.title: US-05: View training progress

## Changes

Implements the persistence foundation for trainings and individual
learner assignments.

- Add User, Role, Training and TrainingAssignment entities.
- Add repositories for users, trainings and assignments.
- Add Flyway V1 migration with foreign keys, validation constraints
  and a unique training/learner assignment constraint.
- Store completion per assignment so learners have independent statuses.

Minimal user persistence supports creator and learner references.
Authentication, API operations and permission enforcement are outside
this change.

## Validation

- Backend started successfully with Hibernate schema validation.
- Flyway V1 applied successfully.
- Database tables and constraints inspected.
- Transactional SQL check confirmed independent completion statuses
  for two learners assigned to the same training.
- Temporary verification records rolled back.

Automated repository save/read tests have not been run.

## Follow-up

- Microsoft Whiteboard data model is pending.

closes #21

## Changes

Add GET /api/dev/learners/{learnerId}/trainings under the local profile.

- Retrieve assignments filtered by learner ID.
- Fetch training details in the repository query.
- Return assignment ID, training ID, name and completion information.
- Sort by training name and assignment ID.
- Return 200 OK with [] when no assignments match.

## Validation

Manually verified in Postman:
- Empty assignment list.
- Incomplete assignment.
- Completed assignment with a UTC timestamp.
- Learner 4 receives their assignment; learner 5 receives [].

Automated retrieval tests are tracked in #23.

## Limitations

The endpoint is for local development and has no authentication
or authorization. The learner ID is supplied in the URL.
An unknown learner ID also returns [].

A protected endpoint using authenticated identity remains a follow-up.

closes #22

Implement training creation, editing, assignment management and deletion,

- Admins and learner creators can edit training names.
- Assignment updates preserve completion for retained learners.
- Removing assignments removes their completion records.
- Admins can delete assigned trainings.

- Update PostgreSQL JDBC to 42.7.14 to address a dependency warning.

- Full Maven test suite passed.
- Postman verified creation, editing, assignment changes and deletion.
- Learner assignment selection was rejected with 403 Forbidden.

Controllers are enabled only under the local profile.
X-Dev-Actor-Id selects the acting user for development testing.
This header is not authentication.

Replace development identity selection with authenticated identity
and expose protected endpoints.
